segments.text: Makoto's underclassman who is 1/4 of Scandinavian descent. She knows Makoto from church, and for whatever reason she came to a Japanese art academy. She works as a waitress with Makoto at Kyouko's café: the Modulor.

Inconsistent with age and height, although she appears to be mature and reliable, she is actually introverted and unsociable. Because she desperately wants to hide it, when in class she feels isolated. She works at the same place as Makoto, and because she can talk to him normally, she trusts him.
Later, thanks to Makoto, she becomes friends with Tsukuyo, Asuza and Madoka.
Arisa seems to be able to speak at least five languages: Finnish, Swedish and Japanese as her mother tongues as well as French and English.
Arisa seems to have been in love with Makoto for a very long time, however only Kyouko seems to have noticed it, at first.

Arisa does not really have a favorite artistic field as she mainly helps her Senpais to finish their work and she is very interested in everything she does. However, we learn later that Arisa seems to be more attracted to painting.
During the game, Arisa passes her first year and moves to the next grade (second year). At the end of the game, she passes her second year and moves in third year.

Even though Arisa is of a shy temperament, she remains a very strong woman, a true iron lady who does not let herself get on her feet when someone tries to intimidate her, to such an extent that she scares even those who have tried to intimidate her.
Hijiri is the first friend that Arisa made by her own.

Although she is not yet of legal drinking age, Arisa drinks alcohol regularly and she can handle it very well. However, she once had too much drunk and ended up completely drunk and slumped on the floor. This story still makes Kyouko and Makoto laugh a lot.
Arisa seems to masturbate using as a fragrant stimulant the tissues she found in Makoto's trash can and which were used for the same purpose.

The fact that Arisa is a perfect Finnish-Swedish bilingual can give us a clue about her region of origin in Finland (in one of the bilingual regions of the south-west of the country), her ability to speak French also gives us an additional clue, suggesting that she must come from the region of Uusimaa.
Arisa is mentioned in Ai Kiss 2 as being one of the famous graduate.

(主人公とは血縁上、「はとこ(またいとこ) 」になる。)

年齢の割に背が高く、見た目もありしっかり者に見えるが、実際はコミュニケーションが苦手で奥手、引っ込み思案。

Amane is the daughter of the Judo Dōjō's master where Shuuji used to learn. She was there was her eldest and so her mentor. Nowaday, she is a third-year student and is close to a high school not far from Konomi's middle school, who is now her apprentice at the dōjō. She's foul-mouthed and calmly spits abusive language at people because of which she isn't popular despite her great looks.

A few years ago, Shuuji badly wounded her in the left leg during a fight and she had to be operated because the wound was severe. During her convalescence in the hospital, Shuuji decided to go see her and go to confess her feelings for her with a bouquet of flowers and that's how they started to go out together.

Because of her injury, Amane can no longer fight and can no longer compete in judo competitions. After a few years, Amane broke her relationship with Shuuji because he did not treat her like a girlfriend (the only "intimate" thing that Shuuji had done to her was to massage her shoulders and back) but they remained good friends.

One day, as she was returning home, Amane was surrounded by thugs who wanted to force her to have sex with them. Unable to fight, Amane was in a bad situation. Shuuji then intervened so that the thugs give up the case, but one of them then left a knife. Shuuji then attacked the first and made a real carnage by exploding them violently. Because of this incident, Shuuji was excommunicated from the dōjō in front of all the students because he violated the rules of judo and has used it to attack people (even if it was justified). It was the last time he saw Amane before seeing her again, when she takes her protégé Konomi to see how her step brother is, at Aoi's house the following year.
The dōjō of her family works so well that he even attracts police officers who come to train. Thanks to that, Amane's family is quite wealthy, and they have many cars in their garage.
Amane has a great passion for driving, she passed her driving license not long ago. She always does judo, but only gives lessons with her father and doesn't fight.
She is the most popular girl in her high school, but no boys approach her because she sends them away violently.

Amane didn't leave Shuuji because she didn't love him anymore, on the contrary, she still loves him very much. She left Shuuji because she felt very upset that he never tried to have sex with her, or even to kiss her at least one time. Her pride took a big hit and she thought it was her lack of coquetry that was the culprit (in addition to Shuuji's lack of courage) so she decided to become more feminine before seeing him again. When she comes back to see him in Aoi's house and sees that he is with Itsuki, she is certain that he doesn't actually go out with her, but she keeps it to herself.

On the contrary, she realizes that Shuuji is very attractive for the other girls too, she even begins to believe that Shuuji slept with Aoi, Itsuki or someone else. Also realizing that Shuuji could fall in love with another girl, Amane promises to herself not to get in their way and lets things happen, however, if she sees that Shuuji is not interested in any of the other girls he frequents, she will not hesitate to take him for her.

A third year in the school, is Kanade's older sister and Souji's first love, he's been calling her "Haya-nee". Although she's just a year older, she appears to be even older and is like tolerance incarnate. She immediately hugs people close to her and compliments them along with a pat on his head.
She is bad at cleaning her room and cooking, but her skill at making sweets is on the level of a pro, her crepes are especially good.

She sometimes staggers and has problems holding her balance, which is blamed on her "extremely self-asserting big breasts". She often walks around her home without a bra, or wearing just a towel after coming out of the bath.
学園の３年生で、主人公の初恋相手。
「ハヤ姉」と呼ばれていた。
１つ上なのに、それ以上の年上に見える包容力の塊。
すぐに抱きしめて「よしよし」と撫でて褒めてくる。
部屋の片づけを始め、家事が苦手だが、お菓子作りだけはプロ並で、特にクレープは絶品。
ふらついたり、バランスが取れていない理由に、『自己主張激しい巨乳』のせいもある。
ノーブラだったり、風呂あがりにバスタオル１枚で家の中をうろついたりする。
学園の3年生で、総司の初恋相手。 総司には “ハヤ姉” と呼ばれていた。
実年齢よりも年上に見える包容力の塊。 すぐに抱きしめて 「よしよし」 と撫でて褒めてくる。
部屋の片づけを始め家事は苦手だが、お菓子作りだけはプロ並。 特にクレープは絶品。
家ではノーブラだったり、風呂あがりにバスタオル 1枚で家の中をうろついたりする。
よくふらついているが、その理由に “自己主張の激しい巨乳” がある。
「昔はも～っと、ハヤ姉 ハヤ姉って懐いてきてて、可愛かったのに～。」

A senpai thought by the surroundings to be a cool person and feared a little. She is a former member of the school athletics club and was known to have been one of the best of her time. As a result, she is now taller, more muscular and stronger than an average girl. Ryouichi even thinks she's probably stronger than him. Despite this body that Kaede describes as "not really feminine" she is seen and considered as one of the most beautiful girls in the school by all students.

She hates boasting of talents and hard work and people who do that, and doesn't acknowledge that of her own. Moreover, she doesn't boast of her own pretty looks. However, she doesn't disparage herself, it's just that she doesn't appeal her own good points.

Also, she doesn't believe in ANY fortunetelling, the reason for that is because "I'm easy to trick", she says. Similarly to the fortunetelling, she can be easily deceived by a well thought up story. Basically, she's quite simple a person.

Shigure's classmate who is a popular girl. Her friendly and honest personality gave Misaki the popularity she currently has. When she is embarrassed, she has a habit of flailing her fists around. She also tends to sometimes run away when she's teased, but that's also part of her overall charm.

Because of her personality and for the fact she is extremely cute, the guys around her think she must have a boyfriend and which is why nobody attempts to confess to her. However, because of that fact, her relationships with her classmates have never become anything deeper or genuine like "friendship". She becomes interested in Shigeru after he told her about gojoken, and survived through their tests thanks to the cheat sheets she bought from there.
Translated from the official website

Yumi is Chiharu's best friend and classmate as well as Ichio and Seiji. In the top of the best students in the class, Yumi is a very smart girl. Very close to Chiharu, she became extremely worried for her when she learned that Tomoko-senpai had chosen Ichio "the naked man" as a volunteer to help her prepare for the Christmas party. As a good friend, she joins Ichio so that she can keep an eye on him and he doesn't attack his friend Chiharu.

However, while they were cleaning the old school chapel to serve as their operating room, Yumi got her feet tangled and a pile of cardboard began to fall on her when heroically, Ichio used his body as a shield to protect the young girl's beauty. Touched by his chivalrous action, Yumi decided to join the group as a volunteer in order to pay her debt.
Yumi is a cold girl, who doesn't show her emotions as easily as other people. However, she has an S side that expresses itself willingly when it comes to annoying her friends.
She is the first girl to show more than friendly interest in Ichio.

She is the class representative in her second year, with a calm and gentle appearance. Her words and actions are characterized by an extremely relaxed and leisurely pace, with each action not being particularly quick. However, this doesn't mean she's slow, and her movements are normal in speed. She has a clear distinction between moments of stillness and moments of movement.

She may seem indifferent to her surroundings, but she has a good understanding of them and moves at her own pace while avoiding anything that may hinder her. She secretly moves to a position where she won't be disturbed.

Her appearance as a gentle and refined lady has made her popular among her classmates, with her popularity being on par with that of the student council president. She has excellent grades, especially in math. As the treasurer of the Christmas committee, she holds the purse strings and is a formidable opponent who won't give in to the protagonist's demands easily. She enjoys puzzle games and detective novels that require critical thinking.
